'''Sam Haft''' is an American actor who works on the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}. Until {{aniseries|HZ}}, he was credited as '''Sam Black'''. He is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Biography==
Haft is an actor, musician, and songwriter and also works on a few English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}. His most notable role so far is that of [[Kiawe's Marowak]].
